items: A new look on Apple TV: your top match big on Now, icons in the tab bar, and full-screen Your Sports and category pages.
Sports rows show the channel found for live matches and those starting soon, in your language.
Back Up Now shows the spinning globe while it works, then Backed Up.

description: Find the match. Fix the stream. Keep watching. Amaviro is a TV player for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV that finds the channel showing your game and sorts out what goes wrong, on the TV service you already pay for.
